reasoning: The icon shows the upper binaural tubing of a stethoscope paired with a checkmark in place of the chestpiece. It naturally represents medical checkups, physical exams, health clearances, doctor appointments, or system health checks. Because the circular diaphragm of the stethoscope is omitted to make room for the checkmark, the remaining U-shape is slightly less recognizable at tiny sizes than a full stethoscope.
